source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio campus publishes 36 MW of IT capacity across 295,785 square feet, making it the fourth largest campus in Texas by disclosed megawatts.

The 36 MW is a single figure for three buildings, SAT2 through SAT4. It is not broken down by building, and no rack count or tenant is named. Converting it to racks requires assuming a density the operator does not publish: about 900 racks at 40 kW each, about 360 at 100 kW each. Those are arithmetic, not claims.

The certifications describe what workloads the campus can host, not who occupies it. PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942 each cover a category of data or control. None identifies a customer.

Texas has 137 mapped facilities, but only 19 publish a power figure, totaling 475.41 MW. The ranking rests on that subset. Most of the state's mapped capacity is invisible to this comparison, so 36 MW is a meaningful share of what has been disclosed, not of what exists.
